summary: Full frontend flow validation of Stock Allocation + Offline Order feature across Sales Manager, District Manager and Inventory Manager dashboards. Backend already verified via curl by main agent. All 7 requested scenarios executed via Playwright. All PASS with one minor testid naming discrepancy documented below.

issues: Benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' error surfaces as an intrusive full-screen dev overlay after some interactions (SM allocation save). Not a functional bug but noisy — consider swallowing it with a global window.addEventListener('error', ...) or CRA's ignore list.

Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' on the sell dialog — DialogDescription is present but Radix still complains; ensure a stable aria-describedby id. Non-blocking.

test_results.1_sm_allocate_stock: PASS — tab-stock visible for sales_manager, panel + alloc-add-btn render, dialog opens, employee dropdown includes all required roles (telecaller, agent, sales_manager, district_manager, assistant_sales_manager, inventory_manager), allocation with unit_price=299.5 saved with success toast.
test_results.2_manual_unit_price_fallback: PASS — With blank unit_price the helper shows 'Product default: Rs.499.00 · Total value @ Qty 3: Rs.1497.00'. Saved allocation card shows '(product default)' badge (verified via alloc-grid inner text).
test_results.3_dm_tab_stock: PASS — district_manager (manager1) sees tab-stock, click renders stock-allocation-panel.
test_results.4_im_sell_offline_order: PASS — IM opens alloc panel via inv-tab-allocation (see note), clicked alloc-sell-{id}, dialog opened, filled qty=2, price=150, customer, phone, upi, notes; alloc-sell-total auto-computed; alloc-sell-submit created order with 'Offline order created' toast.
test_results.5_offline_badge_list_pipeline: PASS — inv-offline-<orderId> badge visible on OFF-20260708-CA7500 row in List tab; inv-offline-pipe-<orderId> badge visible in Pipeline delivered column.
test_results.6_filter_chips: PASS — inv-filter-offline shows only 1 offline row (with badge); inv-filter-online shows 9 rows with 0 offline badges; inv-filter-all resets.
test_results.7_stock_deduction: IMPLICIT PASS — Offline order successfully created via UI (see #4), backend already curl-verified by main agent that product.stock is decremented + alloc.sold_qty is incremented. Not re-checked in DB from UI in this run.

action_items: MINOR (docs/testid naming): The review request specified data-testid='tab-allocation' for IM's Stock Allocation tab, but the actual code uses data-testid='inv-tab-allocation'. Both work fine; either update the request docs or rename to 'tab-allocation' for consistency with SM/DM 'tab-stock'.
OPTIONAL: Suppress the ResizeObserver runtime error overlay (react-error-overlay noise) — not functional but poor UX during allocate save.
critical_code_review_comments: stock_allocation.py: create_offline_order rejects effective_price <= 0 with 400 — good. However revenue transaction recording is wrapped in bare `except Exception: pass` — silent failure. Consider logging.
StockAllocationPanel.jsx (~325 lines) is within limits. Well-structured.
InventoryManagerDashboard.js: single very long line (line 383) for the table row — hurts readability & diffs, but not a bug.
The employee dropdown lists all managers including the current logged-in user (SM sees themselves) — probably intentional (they can hold their own stock), but consider a subtle 'You' tag.
